description: This file defines API routes for user authentication, including signup and login functionalities, implemented using FastAPI. It handles user registration, password hashing, credential verification, and JWT token generation.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User ORM model representing user data in the database.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: Schema for authentication responses, including JWT token and user info.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Schema for error messages returned by API responses.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request payload containing email and password.

classes.name: SignupRequest
classes.description: Schema for signup request payload containing user registration details.

methods.name: AuthResponse signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint for registering a new user, storing data in the database, and returning a JWT token.

methods.name: AuthResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint for authenticating an existing user and returning a JWT token upon success.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/
